hook: India's draft lab rules put our animals in danger.

beats.label: Draft rules · Gazette, 6 October 2026
beats.say: A new draft, {G.S.R. 864(E)|G S R eight sixty-four E}, would roll back protections in force since {1998|nineteen ninety-eight}. Once lost, they will not return.

beats.label: Rules 5(1), 5(2), 5(3)
beats.say: Stray, feral and even protected wild animals could be taken for experiments, on the word of an undefined competent authority.

beats.label: Rule 21(2)
beats.say: {Rule 21(2)|Rule twenty-one, two} reopens open-market buying of livestock, fish and birds. In 2006, this needed written permission.

scene.before: Rule 21(2), as drafted, includes the words:
scene.note: Our ask: delete these words and restore the 2006 requirement of written permission.

beats.label: Rule 11 · severe experiments
beats.say: Severe experiments on mice, rats and rabbits have no stated approver. They fall between two rules.

beats.label: Anaesthesia duty dropped
beats.say: The draft drops the duty to give anaesthesia, which the {1998|nineteen ninety-eight} rules required. Suffering need not be eased.

scene.title: Rule 9(d), 1998 Rules
scene.text: Anaesthesia for any procedure more severe than a simple inoculation or superficial venesection.

beats.label: Clause by clause
beats.say: Some parts of the draft are better. But these losses are major. We ask for sixteen fixes, or a full redraft.

asks: Keep large animals with the Committee
A laboratory must be a place
Stop using animals to teach manual skills
End severe pain, not just long pain
Test the rules against the Act
Ask the Ministry to raise the fine

outro: Object before {5 November|the fifth of November}. Email {cpcsea-mef@gov.in|C P C S E A, dash, M E F, at gov dot in}, or use {protectouranimals.in|protect our animals dot in}.

end.title: Object by 5 November 2026
end.small: Takes two minutes. Sent from your own inbox. Quote G.S.R. 864(E), dated 30 September 2026.
